text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I-I did it...! I took 1st place! First 
placeee!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
D-Did ya see that, damn it!! THIS! Is! My! 
True power!!
choice_data_list:
We need to show everyone just how strong 
you are!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm strong! I've trained like hell 
up till now, after all...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course! I've been doing all kinds 
of menus just like you said...! We even 
came up with special training together--

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
............ I-It's not like I owe you one 
or anything!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Even without you butting in, I was strong 
to begin with, damn it!

Even as she said that, Espoir City's lips 
curved into a smile from the joy of 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, aah~!? Are you trying to say I'm 
getting carried away~?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Tsk! I know that already... Racing 
ain't so soft that one good result today 
makes you the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Next up! I ain't letting up my guard, I'm 
gonna keep on winning!

Until the day I stack victory upon victory 
and can call myself the undisputed 
"strongest"— I will keep working hard once 
more.
